votes.motion: An implied motion to approve Resolution 2025-39, as currently constituted, has been                     made by council rule. Mayor Kaufusi recommended Brooke Barnes, Doug Gardner, Bonnie Morrow, Brittany Hyde, and Dan Mitchell for appointments to the Parks and Recreation board.
An implied motion to approve Resolution 2025-40, as currently constituted, has been                     made by council rule. Melissa McNalley, Community Grant Administrator, presented.
An implied motion to approve Resolution 2025-41, as currently constituted, has been                     made by council rule. Jessica Dahneke, City Planner, presented.
Councilor Bogdin made a motion to remove the November 17 meeting citing reduced                     activity around the holidays. Seconded by Councilor MacKay.
